title: nexu-io/html-anything
claim: nexu-io/html-anything — ✨ The agentic HTML editor — your local AI agent writes the HTML, you ship it. 🚀 75 Skills × 9 Surfaces (magazine · deck
why_good: HTML Anything is a local-first agentic HTML editor that detects your existing coding-agent CLI (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) and uses 75 skill templates to generate polished single-file HTML for magazines, decks, résumés, posters, social cards, and more. It exports to WeChat, X, Zhihu, or downloads .html/.png.
value: Indie hackers and content creators pay for a subscription to get beautiful, shareable HTML pages without design skills, saving hours per piece.
risk: The incumbent is the coding agents themselves (Claude Code, Cursor) that could add this as a built-in feature, killing the standalone tool.

voices.quote: …e if the PPTX has been successfully generated. I don't know where the PPTX file is saved. I can't find the exported PPTX document in the "html--anything" directory.

does: HTML Anything is a local-first agentic HTML editor that detects your existing coding-agent CLI (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) and uses 75 skill templates to generate polished single-file HTML for magazines, decks, résumés, posters, social cards, and more. It exports to WeChat, X, Zhihu, or downloads .html/.png.
why_use: Because Markdown renders ugly when shared, and hand-writing HTML/CSS is a chore. This tool gives you designer-quality output from plain text, in seconds, without leaving your terminal or needing an API key.
gap: The tool is powerful but still requires technical setup and lacks a polished, non-technical user experience.
counter: It's a feature, not a company. Claude Code and other agents could add HTML export natively, and the niche is narrow—most writers won't install a CLI tool.
differentiator: Package it as a GUI app for non-technical creators, with one-click templates for Chinese platforms like WeChat and Xiaohongshu, and a local-private version for teams.
hook: Writers and indie hackers who are tired of ugly Markdown exports and want their content to look designed without touching CSS or hiring a designer.

zh.claim: 代理式 HTML 编辑器，通过本地 AI 代理将任何输入转化为可直接发布的单文件 HTML，拥有 75 个技能模板和 9 种输出表面，一键导出到微信、X、知乎。
zh.hook: 厌倦了 Markdown 导出丑陋的写作者和独立开发者，想要内容看起来经过设计，却不想碰 CSS 或雇设计师。
zh.does: HTML Anything 是一个本地优先的代理式 HTML 编辑器，能检测你已有的编码代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等），并使用 75 个技能模板生成精美的单文件 HTML，适用于杂志、演示文稿、简历、海报、社交媒体卡片等。支持一键导出到微信、X、知乎，或下载 .html/.png。
zh.why_use: 因为 Markdown 在分享时渲染效果差，而手写 HTML/CSS 又很麻烦。这个工具能让你从纯文本快速获得设计师级别的输出，无需离开终端或使用 API 密钥。
zh.gap: 只有极客能用：它是 CLI 工具，没有图形界面，而且中国市场案例空白——除了基本导出外，没有针对中国社交平台的本地化模板。
zh.counter: 它只是一个功能，不是一家公司。Claude Code 等代理可以原生添加 HTML 导出，而且这个利基市场很窄——大多数写作者不会安装 CLI 工具。
zh.differentiator: 将其打包为面向非技术创作者的 GUI 应用，提供针对微信、小红书等中国平台的一键模板，并提供团队本地私有版本。
zh.value: 独立开发者和内容创作者订阅付费，以无需设计技能即可获得美观、可分享的 HTML 页面，每篇节省数小时。
zh.risk: 现有竞争对手是编码代理本身（如 Claude Code、Cursor），它们可能将此作为内置功能，从而扼杀独立工具。
zh.why_good: HTML Anything 是一个本地优先的代理式 HTML 编辑器，能检测你已有的编码代理 CLI（如 Claude Code、Cursor 等），并使用 75 个技能模板生成精美的单文件 HTML，适用于杂志、演示文稿、简历、海报、社交媒体卡片等。支持一键导出到微信、X、知乎，或下载 .html/.png。

consumer_angle: Ordinary people can create professional-looking HTML documents (magazines, resumes, social cards) without coding, but the current interface and workflow are still developer-oriented.
pick_reason: High stars and forks indicate interest, but no direct evidence of user pain or willingness to pay; the gap is clear but the wedge is not fully proven.
